question.knowledge_point: Identifying Operations That Would Transform a Matrix To Row Echelon Form
question.problem:
Consider the matrix $A$ given below.
Which entries of $A$ could be replaced by $0$ in order to get a matrix in row echelon form?

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 4 & 7 \\ 2 & 4 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & 6 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$
question.worked_solution:
Notice that by replacing ${a}_{21}$ and ${a}_{43}$ with $0$, we get a matrix in row echelon form:

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 4 & 7 \\ 2 & 4 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & 6 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 3\end{aligned}]\,⟶\,[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 4 & 7 \\ 0 & 4 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & 6 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$

The other options will not give us a matrix in row echelon form.
